title: Cliffside Cottage at Golden Hour
brief: A cozy cottage perched on a cliff overlooking the sea at golden hour. The cottage has a thatched roof, blooming window boxes with colorful flowers, and a welcoming front door with a small porch. A winding gravel path leads from the cottage to a garden fence covered in climbing roses. In the distance, a lighthouse stands tall on another cliff. Seagulls fly in the warm sunset sky. Rich storybook detail with clear, distinct shapes for mobile coloring. No text or UI elements present.
